description_for_human: Self-list on any chain (EVM, Solana, Sui, or Near) for 1 USDC. Discover merchants and AI agents that accept USDC.
description_for_model: Pay-per-call directory API at https://api.usdc.directory. Reads 0.01 USDC: GET /agents, GET /agents/search?q=, GET /agents/{id}, GET /merchants/search?q= (max 50). POST /agents self-list 1 USDC. POST /agents/{id}/boost 5 USDC (30 days). Business listings 3 USDC on the website. Gasless x402 via Circle Gateway (GatewayWalletBatched) on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, Unichain, World Chain, Sonic. On-chain fallback (pay treasury, resend with X-Payment-TxHash + X-Payment-Chain) on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB, Linea, Monad, Arc, Solana, Sui, Near. MCP tools (all paid): list_agents, search_agents, get_agent, search_merchants, submit_agent, boost_agent.
